findings.headline: US-Japan coordinated yen intervention — largest single-day FX intervention in history ($53B / ¥8.45T)
findings.source: CNBC, OMFIF, CMG Private Wealth, The Economist
findings.summary: Unprecedented US-Japan coordinated intervention to defend the yen. US Treasury Secretary Bessent joined Japan in defending the yen using American foreign-exchange reserves. USD/JPY trading near 159.35 as of Aug 11 despite intervention. BoJ signaling continued rate hikes toward 3%, which would be like 'going to the moon' after 20 years of 0% rates. Jim Rickards calls it 'the financial equivalent of all-out nuclear war' — the biggest story in the world.

findings.headline: ECB officials view US use of euros in trade as 'unprecedented breach of monetary cooperation conventions'
findings.summary: Senior ECB officials reportedly viewed the US decision to use euros in its trade actions as an unprecedented breach of longstanding conventions on cooperation between western monetary authorities. This represents a verbal intervention signal of fracturing western monetary alliance.

findings.headline: Bloomberg op-ed: Fed, ECB, and BoE 'must communicate better, not less' — transparency revolution under strain
findings.summary: New Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's limited forward guidance creating market uncertainty. The FOMC left rates on hold, generating initial relief but the lack of communication clarity is itself a signal. Central bank communication infrastructure is fraying.

findings.headline: US government surveillance of organizations never accused of crimes — expansive financial records obtained
findings.summary: NYT reporting that the government conducted expansive surveillance, infiltrated group chats and obtained financial records of organizations never accused of crimes. This is a leak/whistleblower signal suggesting internal dissent within government ranks.

findings.headline: US government group chat leaks — national security leaders' Signal chat exposed
findings.summary: Continuing fallout from the March 2025 US government group chat leak incident where national security leaders were observed on a group chat discussing relations with Europe, protecting Saudi oil facilities, and Yemen operations. The incident remains a live story.

findings.headline: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh leaves rates on hold with limited forward guidance — market pricing uncertainty
findings.summary: FOMC decision to hold rates generated initial market relief as the market had been pricing a higher-than-normal probability of a surprise hike amid limited forward guidance from new Fed Chair Kevin Warsh. USD weakened against all G10 currencies following the decision, reinforced by intervention and a soft NFP report.

findings.headline: BoJ signaling continued rate hikes toward 3% — 'like going to the moon' after 20 years of 0%
findings.source: Economic Collapse Blog, CNBC, The Economist
findings.summary: Bank of Japan is signaling it will keep raising interest rates. Even 3% for yen interest rates is described as 'like going to the moon' when it's been 0% for 20 years. The yen carry trade is actively unwinding. The US is using Fed dollars to prop up the yen so Japan doesn't have to raise rates fast, so the carry trade doesn't unwind, so markets don't collapse.

findings.headline: ECB independence risks rise with debt — France 120% and Italy 130% debt-to-GDP ratios
findings.summary: Commerzbank warns that ECB independence risks are rising with debt levels. France and Italy debt-to-GDP ratios likely to continue rising. This is a structural euro area risk signal.

findings.headline: Four-way geopolitical convergence: Strait of Hormuz + Russia-Ukraine escalation + North Korea integration + US-China multi-domain confrontation
findings.summary: First week of August 2026 delivered a concentrated burst of geopolitical signals that, taken together, describe the convergence of four previously distinct crises: the Strait of Hormuz closure and contested reopening, Russia's escalating missile campaign against Ukraine, deepening of North Korea's military integration into the European war, and transformation of US-China economic rivalry into a multi-domain confrontation spanning trade, maritime sovereignty, and energy politics.

findings.headline: Strait of Hormuz crisis — Iran demands US lift blockade before Tehran opens Hormuz; oil +5%
findings.summary: Active crisis: Iran's Foreign Ministry says US must lift its blockade before Tehran will fully open Hormuz. Trump claims 'complete control' over the strait. Iran reportedly allowing only Chinese vessels to pass. Oil prices jumped ~5% on doubt a deal will be reached. Houthi rebels escalating strikes on Saudi oil tankers — claimed missile attack on Saudi tanker Wafa on Aug 5.

findings.headline: CISA maintains elevated advisory posture for energy, financial, and defense networks — DEFCON level elevated
findings.summary: CISA maintaining elevated advisory posture for critical infrastructure (energy, financial, defense networks) as of August 2026. Geopolitical conditions warrant heightened alert status.

findings.headline: Container rates extend gains as carriers tighten transpacific capacity amid widespread supply chain disruption
findings.summary: Container rates extending gains for straight weeks, with higher transpacific rates outweighing declines on Asia-Europe trades as carriers continue to manage capacity amid widespread supply chain disruption.

findings.headline: Ningbo port suspends container operations; Shanghai flooding — China shipping paralyzed
findings.summary: Ningbo suspended several port activities from August 7, including container gate operations, feeder services and vessel movements. Shanghai also experienced severe rainfall, flooding and widespread flight cancellations. Two of China's largest ports disrupted simultaneously.

findings.headline: US import cargo slowing past August as peak season cut short amid tariff shifts and geopolitical disruption
findings.summary: US container imports forecast to stay elevated for August before gradually decreasing through end of 2026. Peak shipping season cut short. August forecast at 2.22M TEU, down 4.2% YoY. Mexico exports up double digits but visa crackdowns and border scrutiny straining trucking capacity.

findings.headline: OCC opens national bank charters to crypto firms — historic regulatory shift
findings.summary: US bank regulator OCC says lawful crypto firms should have a path to national bank status. Gould's statement indicates OCC will keep accepting applications from digital asset businesses rather than impose blanket exclusion. This is a major regulatory shift toward institutionalizing crypto within the US banking system.

findings.headline: Digital Asset Market Clarity Act (H.R.3633) — SEC to discuss easing crypto rules at August meeting
findings.summary: Digital Asset Market Clarity Act progressing through Congress. SEC to discuss easing crypto rules at August 2026 meeting. CFTC and SEC both positioning US as 'crypto capital of the world.' Senate delayed vote on CLARITY Act until after August recess, removing near-term catalyst.

findings.headline: 2025-2026 Iranian protests — nationwide protests and strikes continue
findings.summary: Ongoing nationwide protests and strikes in Iran. Iran has repeatedly accused Kurdish militias from Iraq of attempting to incite unrest, including in the 2026 protests. This is a persistent instability signal in a geopolitically critical region.

findings.headline: Flamingo Revolution — Albania protests over media capture and political influence
findings.summary: Protests in Albania driven by concerns over media capture and political influence over public information. Albania ranked 83rd in 2026 World Press Freedom Index. This is a European instability signal, minor but worth tracking.

findings.headline: Anti-racism protests across Australia — students shun calls to stay in school
findings.summary: Anti-racism rallies across Australia, with protesters gathering in multiple cities. Driver allegedly rammed into protester at Melbourne rally. Social polarization increasing in typically stable democracies.

findings.headline: 10-year US Treasury yield surges past 5.4% — highest since late 2007
findings.summary: The 10-year U.S. Treasury yield surged past 5.4%, its highest level since late 2007, rattling equity markets, pressuring corporate credit spreads, and forcing a fundamental reassessment of portfolio construction across Wall Street. This is a major financial stress precursor.

findings.headline: HY credit spreads at 271 bps — default risk pricing elevated but not crisis-level yet
findings.summary: ICE BofA High Yield Option-Adjusted Spread at 271 bps as of Aug 6, 2026. Not yet at crisis levels (400+ bps), but rising. St. Louis Fed Financial Stress Index (STLFSI4) being actively monitored. Spreads becoming much higher signals market fear of corporate defaults.

findings.headline: Recession probability model at 15.19% — yield curve signal active
findings.summary: Yield Curve recession probability model shows 15.1874% probability of US recession twelve months ahead (through July 2026 data). Sahm Rule Recession Indicator being actively tracked via FRED. Not yet signaling recession but elevated and trending.

findings.headline: Bitcoin below $63K — Yemen drone strike on Saudi oil refinery triggers flash crash
findings.summary: BTC randomly nuked from $63.9K to $62.8K due to Yemen drone strike on Saudi oil refinery. Bitcoin has taken 10 bearish blows in 2026, daily/weekly/monthly/yearly price trends all negative. Could test $50K if macroeconomic pressure intensifies. $47M in long positions liquidated. Senate CLARITY Act delay removing catalysts.

japan_yen.assessment: Japan yen carry trade unwinding is the single most active macro thread. Historic $53B intervention failed to halt yen slide. BoJ signaling 3% rates. US using Fed dollars to prevent carry trade unwind. This is actively developing — convergence of verbal intervention and central bank communication signals.

us_recession.assessment: MASSIVE convergence across 5 categories. 10Y Treasury at 5.4% (highest since 2007), recession probability at 15.19%, HY spreads at 271bps and rising, Fed Chair Warsh providing minimal forward guidance, soft NFP, import cargo declining, and government surveillance leaks suggesting internal instability. This is the dominant macro thread.

middle_east_war.assessment: Active convergence across 5 categories. Strait of Hormuz crisis is live and escalating. Iran demanding US lift blockade, Houthis striking Saudi tankers, oil +5%, CISA elevated posture, Iranian domestic protests ongoing, crypto flash-crashing on Middle East news. This is an active geopolitical crisis with financial market contagion.

china_collapse.assessment: China's $148B property time bomb, collapsing property market, cautious consumers, stalling economic engine. Ningbo and Shanghai ports disrupted. US-China multi-domain confrontation escalating. Iran allowing only Chinese vessels through Hormuz. Convergence developing across geopolitics and supply chains.

euro_crisis.assessment: ECB independence risks rising with debt. France 120% and Italy 130% debt-to-GDP. ECB officials view US monetary cooperation as breached. Albania protests. Not yet at convergence threshold but structural risks are building. Watch for Italian bond spread widening.

asian_contagion.assessment: BoJ rate hikes + Ningbo/Shanghai port disruption could spread through Asian supply chains. Early stage, not yet at threshold.

crypto_collapse.assessment: BTC below $63K with all timeframes negative. Regulatory framework advancing (OCC bank charters, CLARITY Act) but Senate delays removing near-term catalysts. Middle East geopolitical risk bleeding into crypto. Not at convergence threshold but deteriorating.

global_pandemic.assessment: No lead indicators pointing to pandemic risk.

summary.key_narrative: Two macro threads have crossed the ACTIVE threshold: US recession (convergence 112 across 5 categories — 10Y Treasury at 5.4%, recession probability rising, HY spreads widening, Fed communication breakdown, supply chain slowdown) and Middle East war (convergence 100 across 5 categories — Hormuz crisis live, Houthi attacks on Saudi tankers, Iranian protests, oil prices surging, crypto flash-crashing on geopolitical news). Japan yen carry trade unwinding is DEVELOPING at convergence 50 — the largest single-day FX intervention in history failed to halt the yen's slide and BoJ is signaling 3% rates. China collapse is at 40, approaching the DEVELOPING threshold.
